svg.title: Category-theoretic / compositional case outcome heatmap
svg.desc: Every selected case is a heatmap cell. Column headers show exact easy, medium, and hard settings; row badges show judge mode; cell color shows outcome and cell text shows terminal label or exclusion status.

FAIL; tile text gives terminal label
EXCL; retained in raw rows, omitted from performance rates
